HARBOR CITY BUSINESS JOURNAL
Local Tech Roundup -- April 2026

Harbor City software firm eyes compliance milestone

Acme Analytics, the usage-analytics software company headquartered downtown, is
pressing ahead with a SOC 2 security examination this year -- a checkbox that
enterprise customers increasingly demand before signing.

The company, which helps other businesses measure how their products get used,
employs roughly 200 people between its Harbor City headquarters and a distributed
remote workforce. Leadership says the compliance effort is part of a broader push
to win larger, more regulated accounts.

"Security reviews are where enterprise deals are won or lost now," a company
spokesperson said.

Acme is one of a cluster of Harbor City B2B software firms that have quietly
scaled over the past three years. The company declined to share revenue figures.

-- Staff report. Figures are approximate and based on public statements and
interviews; the Journal does not audit company-provided numbers.
